[[Decade Spear "Sun's Revolution"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1 
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1 
:[[Critical Strikes]]: 5 (if your rank is lower. No effect in PvP.) 
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.

==Skin==
This spear shares a [[skin]] with the [[Sunspear (weapon)|Sunspear]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
*This spear leaves behind a cutting trail of purple particles with each [[auto attack]] when the wielder is not under the effects of a [[form]] or [[tonic]]. Its auto attack projectiles also leave a trail of purple particles.
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
* Without attribute points invested in Critical Strikes, the inherent Critical Strikes from this weapon provides 5% additional chance to [[critical hit|critically hit]] and 1 Energy whenever you critically hit.
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this spear's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]].
